SEARCH

Class Wheel

java.lang.Object
Wheel
public class Wheel extends Object
Represents a single wheel of the slot machine. Each wheel owns its own list of symbols and its visual representation: a background Rectangle (slot) and a Traingle that shows the currently visible symbol (visibleShape). Both shapes are created once, with a fixed size; only their color changes when the wheel spins

1.0
